title: Anakin’s Quest
front_description: On Tatooine, Anakin and Padmé find their way to moisture farmer Clieg Lars and his familv. It was Lars who freed Anakin's mother Shmi and married her. But just recently, Shmi was kidnapped by marauding Tusken Raiders and given up for dead. A distraught Anakin cannot acrept this grim conclusion. Sensing she is still alive, he takes off on a speeder and is zooming across the barren wastelands of Tatooine in search of her.
